_source: Remaster data for a Phantasie III import from the Apple II copy alone (profile p3-apple2), applied by the importer (OpenPhantasie.Importer.Pipelines.P3Apple2.P3Apple2Tables.Write) to the GameData P3Apple2Tables builds: DOS III's value in every number / structure cell where the Apple's differs or it has none (the rule of II's Apple and III's Amiga imports: the reference version's numbers), so III plays the same whichever version was imported. The Apple's own text is kept. Made by tools/scripts/diff_a2_p3_vs_dos.py --built ... --cells; the groups: reverse-engineering/apple2/phantasie3/FORMAT.md 'Apple != DOS'.
_dos_cells: As phantasie3/amiga-import.json (CellPatches): a path into the GameData file the Apple import builds; a string is an object key, a number an array index; 'byte' = an offset into a hex string. A cell holding the Apple value takes the DOS value; one holding neither is kept and warned. Whole arrays or objects where the shapes differ; map rows whole.
